subject: psychology

moments.title: Cognitive Maps in Rats and Men
moments.body: Tolman argues rats build cognitive maps of mazes rather than S-R chains.
moments.takeaway: Behaviour can be purposive and representational even in rats.

moments.title: Latent learning study
moments.body: Rats that explored a maze without reward later learn faster than naive rats, suggesting silent learning.
moments.takeaway: Learning is not strictly tied to immediate reinforcement.

moments.title: Nobel Prize for place and grid cells
moments.body: The Nobel recognises hippocampal place cells and entorhinal grid cells, the neural substrate of cognitive maps.
moments.takeaway: Behavioural concepts of representation can find a neural home decades later.

now.title: Cognitive maps in neuroscience
now.body: Place and grid cell research links spatial navigation to memory and decision-making more generally.
now.open_questions: How general is the cognitive-map framework beyond physical navigation?

reflection: Tolman wrote inside behaviourism and against it at the same time.
